newsitem.title: USA: Premier enters supply pact with Baxter, Allegiance.
newsitem.headline: Premier enters supply pact with Baxter, Allegiance.

text.p: Premier said Monday it has entered into a seven-year partnership to buy medical and surgical supplies from Baxter International Inc and Allegiance Healthcare Corp.
The pact includes group purchasing agreements for various products and has a potential annual sales volume of about $1 billion a year, Premier said.
Premier is an alliance of hospital and health systems.

The pact and related agreements take effect February 1, and give Premier's hospital and health system owners and affiliates discounts and incentives on Baxter I.V. Systems products and Allegiance surgical and respiratory therapy products, Premier said.

Distribution services are not covered by the pact, although Premier said its affiliates may use the Allegiance distribution system if they choose. Allegiance is the primary distributor of Baxter's products.

Premier said the pact includes group purchasing agreements for intravenous solutions, drug delivery systems, and surgical and respiratory therapy products, among other things. Premier said the agreements represent the largest group purchasing award for healthcare supplies in history.

Premier Inc resulted from the merger of American Healthcare Systems Inc, based in San Diego; SunHealth Alliance, based in Charlotte; and Premier Health Alliance Inc, based in Chicago. Premier serves 250 owners, the 700 hospitals and healthcare facilities they operate, and about 1,100 other affiliated hospital and healthcare organizations, it said.
Allegiance Healthcare is the U.S. operating subsidiary of Allegiance Corp. It became an independent, public company October 1, 1996, after spinning off from Baxter International.
